title: Germantown Condo In The Heart of Music City
description:
On north edge of downtown this one-bedroom condo in a quiet building is close to just about everything that Nashville has to offer - Broadway, Farmers Market, NFL, NHL, Sounds Baseball, Ryman Auditorium, parks and greenways, restaurants and bars, and more.

The Space
-1 bedroom with king size bed
-1 sofa
-1 air mattress
-In-unit washer and dryer
-WiFi
-Fully equipped kitchen

*No parties or loud groups.
*No smoking.
*This unit is on the 3rd floor with only stair access.

Guest access
There is one dedicated parking spot for you to use during your stay. The condo is walking distance to much of what Nashville has to offer.
